name: Newest Claude model
prompt: In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) that uses the official Anthropic JavaScript SDK. Create `ai.mjs` that exports an async function `summarize(text)`: it sends the text to Anthropic's newest and most capable Claude model and returns a one-sentence summary as a string. Create the client inside the function and read the API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable. Install the dependencies with npm.
